exposure: EXTra-uterine Environment for Neonatal Development (EXTEND) support
cohort: The study participants were 10 extremely preterm lambs with a mean gestational age of 91.6 days and a mean weight of 0.98 kg at cannulation.
finding: The EXTEND system successfully supported brain and cardiac development in extremely preterm lamb models for up to 21 days, showing comparable MRI and histological brain findings to controls and physiological cardiac function.
